subjects.authored_statement: prismcode review --repo owner/repository --pr 123 --output report.html obtains the exact PR base and head Git revisions without requiring a pre-existing local checkout.
The default live path gives the existing repository scanner and structural providers clean Git checkouts whose observed revisions equal the GitHub source packet SHAs.
Structure-aware review builds isolated head and base Codegraph indexes and removes every PrismCode-owned repository, worktree, index, and credential helper artifact after success or failure.
--no-structural-graph obtains only the exact head checkout required by deterministic repository scanning.
--repo-root remains an explicit local-checkout override and preserves current exact-revision behavior.
Public GitHub, token-authenticated private repositories, and configured trusted GitHub Enterprise hosts use the same bounded workspace contract.
Never place a token in a Git remote URL, command argument, diagnostic, review metadata, generated HTML, or persisted Git configuration.
Do not replace Git revision and clean-checkout validation with an asserted directory identity.
Do not execute or initialize submodules.
Fail closed when the requested revisions cannot be obtained or do not match the GitHub packet.
Do not add a persistent repository cache in this change.
Persistent clone caches, non-GitHub forges, submodule materialization, sparse-checkout policy, package publication, and changes to deterministic review semantics.

--repo-root defaulted to the current directory. The short command appeared remote-capable because --repo collected GitHub metadata, but it succeeded only when the current directory happened to be a local checkout containing both PR revisions. Even --no-structural-graph required that checkout for its exact head worktree.
The bundled workflow compensated with a full-history checkout, and a user installing PrismCode elsewhere could not review a PR with repository coordinates alone.
prismcode review --repo owner/repository --pr 123 --output report.html is the default live path from any directory.

PrismCode creates a private bare Git source, fetches the GitHub PR head ref and exact base SHA, verifies both observed revisions against the source packet, and passes them into the existing exact-worktree lifecycle.
Structure-aware review initializes isolated Codegraph indexes in the exact head and base worktrees.
--no-structural-graph fetches and materializes only the exact head required by deterministic repository scanning.
--repo-root explicitly substitutes an existing local Git object source and retains the prior exact-revision behavior.
The bundled workflow no longer checks out full history merely to provision review revision objects.
